Private money lending

Capital that moves at the speed of the deal.

Conventional lenders underwrite you. We underwrite the property. That single difference is why an investor with a good deal and an imperfect credit file can close here in days instead of losing the contract.

Get pre‑qualified Call 917-682-3642

Speed

Quick approval and funding processes to help you capitalize on investment opportunities without delay. In a competitive market, certainty of close is worth more to a seller than the last few thousand on price.

Flexibility

Customized loan terms built around the actual plan for the property — the renovation scope, the timeline and the exit — instead of forcing your deal into a product that was designed for someone else's.

Easier qualification

Easier qualification criteria than conventional loans, focusing on the value of the property rather than your credit score. The asset is the collateral, so the asset is what gets examined.

Loan programs

Three ways we fund investors.

All loans are for business purposes and secured by investment property. We don't do owner‑occupied consumer mortgages.

Program 01

Fix and flip financing

Short‑term loans for purchasing and renovating distressed properties, with flexible terms and competitive rates designed to maximize your profit rather than ours.

  • Purchase plus renovation funding
  • Draw schedule matched to the build
  • Term sized to the resale timeline

For: investors buying a property to improve and sell.

Get pre‑qualified

Program 02

Buy and hold financing

Long‑term loans for acquiring rental property, plus stabilized financing that converts an existing fix‑and‑flip loan into a rental property loan when you decide to keep it.

  • Long‑term rental acquisition loans
  • Refinance from short‑term into stabilized debt
  • Ongoing support as the portfolio grows

For: investors keeping property for income.

Get pre‑qualified

Program 03

Bridge loans

Interim financing between a purchase and a sale, with fast approval and terms customized to the timing problem you're actually solving.

  • Buy before the existing property sells
  • Fast approval where timing is the constraint
  • Structured around a defined exit

For: investors caught between two closings.

Get pre‑qualified

Rates, terms and loan‑to‑value are quoted per deal. Every figure depends on the property, the scope of work, the exit and your experience. Nothing here is a commitment to lend, and all loans are subject to underwriting, property review and lender approval.

How it runs

From enquiry to funded.

01

Tell us about the deal

Address, purchase price, scope of work and your exit. Five fields, not a full application.

02

Same‑day read

We tell you quickly whether it's fundable and roughly on what terms — including when the answer is no.

03

Term sheet

Written terms so you can make an offer with confidence, or take a signed contract to the closing table.

04

Property review and close

Valuation and title, then funding. We stay on the file to closing support rather than handing you off.
